Package com.egradx.notification.auth

Class EgradxNotificationAccountMessageSender

java.lang.Object
com.egradx.notification.auth.EgradxNotificationAccountMessageSender
All Implemented Interfaces:
EgradxAccountMessageSender
public class EgradxNotificationAccountMessageSender extends Object implements EgradxAccountMessageSender
Sends egradx-auth's account messages — reset links, invitations, email-change codes and the notices that follow them — by email, to the address itself.

Always to the address, never resolved from a user: an invitation goes to someone who may have no account yet, and an email-change code to an address the account does not have yet. All but the invitation carry no organization, so they go through the application's own mail server; an invitation is sent as its organization, through that organization's email settings if it has any.

None of these can be declined — they are about the account itself — and each type is replaceable(): an application restyles them by shipping or storing its own templates.

egradx-auth calls this inside its transaction for the reset link, the invitation and the code, so each is queued through the outbox if and only if it was stored. A failure propagates and egradx-auth reports it.
